mechanism: Ampicillin disrupts intestinal bacterial flora responsible for vitamin K synthesis, reducing endogenous vitamin K production and potentially decreasing anticoagulant effect in warfarin-treated patients or increasing bleeding risk in vitamin K-dependent coagulation.
action: Monitor coagulation parameters (INR/PT) in patients on concurrent warfarin therapy; consider vitamin K supplementation if prolonged ampicillin use is necessary; educate patients on signs of bleeding.
